articles.description: A drone attack has forced Saudi Arabia to shut its East-West pipeline, escalating the Middle East conflict and threatening to increase global oil prices. The attack, linked to Iranian-backed militias in Iraq and Houthi rebels in Yemen, disrupts the strategic oil transport route and intensifies geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Iraq confirms attacks on Saudi pipeline originated from Iraqi territory and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iraq's government says attacks on a key Saudi oil pipeline were launched from Iraqi territory, pledging to investigate further. Saudi Arabia shut down the major oil pipeline on Friday as a precautionary measure. Iraq has also closed two key border crossings with Iran, halting all traffic until further notice, Iranian state media said. Fears are mounting that gas and oil prices may rise and international shipping could be further disrupted after Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis have seized a key island and captured a Red Sea port. Crude prices have soared above $100 a barrel.
